project_type: Flask monolith, Blueprint-based, Vanilla JS SPA-style frontend
build_system: No build step for frontend — static files served directly by Flask. Python: pip install -r requirements.txt. Server: python run.py (port 8080, debug=False, threaded=True)
test_framework: pytest — run with: python -m pytest tests/ -v
build_command: No frontend build — static files are served directly. Python: pip install -r requirements.txt
verification_instructions: 1. Run: python run.py from d:\College\SEMESTER_3\AI\CrystalAI. 2. Open http://localhost:8080 in browser. 3. Verify pages render with dark glass theme (bg #0D0D1A). 4. Run pytest to confirm no backend regressions: python -m pytest tests/ -v
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. Server on port 8080. DB: SQLite at crystalai_dev.db. CSRF disabled in DevelopmentConfig. Do NOT change any Flask routes, API contracts, or DB schema. Do NOT add Python dependencies. Do NOT push to any remote.
contribution_requirements: No emoji icons — use inline SVG only. Single font: Inter from Google Fonts. marked.js for AI markdown rendering (CDN: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/marked/marked.min.js). All work is pure CSS/HTML/JS changes — no Python code changes except if needed to fix a template include.
key_patterns: Templates extend base.html via {% extends 'base.html' %}. Per-page CSS loaded via {% block extra_css %}. Per-page JS loaded via {% block extra_js %}. API calls via API.get/post/upload/delete in api.js. Toast notifications via showToast(msg, type). Sidebar included via {% include 'partials/sidebar.html' %} only when current_user.is_authenticated. body_class block controls body CSS classes (default: has-sidebar). The chat page has body_class = has-sidebar (default). Auth pages use body_class = auth-page. Landing uses body_class = landing. Chat page currently uses its own .chat-layout that cancels the main-content padding with margin: -2rem. The redesign will change chat.html to use body.chat-page and .app-shell layout instead, avoiding that hack.
directory_structure: CrystalAI/ — project root. app/ — Flask app factory + blueprints (auth, chat, documents, admin, pages). static/css/ — all CSS files (main.css, sidebar.css, chat.css, auth.css, landing.css, dashboard.css, admin.css). static/js/ — all JS files (api.js, sidebar.js, chat.js, documents.js, auth.js, dashboard.js, history.js, profile.js, admin.js). templates/ — Jinja2 templates (base.html, index.html, partials/sidebar.html, student/*.html, admin/*.html, auth/*.html, errors/*.html). .agents/tasks/ — planning artifacts (this directory).
